Your saved cakes

Backup

Designs and uploaded images are kept in this browser only. Save a backup file now and then, and restore it on any device.

Design code

A design code is a line of text that holds a whole cake design: tiers, colors, piping and decorations. Use it to move a design to another device or send it to another artist. To get one: open the cake, then tap "Copy this design's code" and paste it into a text, email or note. To use one: paste the code in the box below and tap "Load pasted code." It replaces the cake you have open, so save that one first (or tap Undo to go back). The sender's cake is never changed. Uploaded pictures and logos aren't included, so send those separately.
